newsitem.title: FRANCE: SNCF railway says 1996 loss is 15.2 billion francs.
newsitem.headline: SNCF railway says 1996 loss is 15.2 billion francs.

text.p: French state railroads Societe Nationale des Chemins de Fer (SNCF) said in a statement its 1996 loss was 15.2 billion French francs ($2.7 billion), including 2.4 billion of exceptional charges.

The figures were due to be released to the central works council on February 26 and to the media on March 6 after a board meeting, but the company brought forward the publication after an article in the La Tribune newspaper.
SNCF said that without the charges, its loss would have been 12.8 billion francs which compares with 16.6 billion for 1995. -- Paris Newsroom +331 4221 5452 ($ = 5.648 French Francs)
